questions.description: 函数内定义局部变量并输出。
questions.code_template:
def show():
    x = 5
    print(___)

show()
questions.solution:
def show():
    x = 5
    print(x)

show()

questions.description: 函数内读取全局变量。
questions.code_template:
x = 10
def show():
    print(___)

show()
questions.solution:
x = 10
def show():
    print(x)

show()

questions.description: 函数外定义变量函数内使用。
questions.code_template:
name = "Tom"
def greet():
    print("Hello",___)

greet()
questions.solution:
name = "Tom"
def greet():
    print("Hello", name)

greet()

questions.description: 用 global 声明修改全局变量。
questions.code_template:
count = 0
def inc():
    global count
    count += 1

inc()
print(___)
questions.solution:
count = 0
def inc():
    global count
    count += 1

inc()
print(count)

questions.description: 局部变量遮蔽全局变量。
questions.code_template:
x = 10
def show():
    x = 20
    print(x)

show()
print(___)
questions.solution:
x = 10
def show():
    x = 20
    print(x)

show()
print(x)

questions.description: 函数内赋值不影响全局。
questions.code_template:
x = 9
def change():
    x = 50

change()
print(___)
questions.solution:
x = 9
def change():
    x = 50

change()
print(x)

questions.description: 函数返回局部变量值。
questions.code_template:
def get():
    x = 7
    return x

print(___)
questions.solution:
def get():
    x = 7
    return x

print(get())

questions.description: 全局变量可被多次读取。
questions.code_template:
total = 3
def add_one():
    print(___)

add_one()
add_one()
questions.solution:
total = 3
def add_one():
    print(total + 1)

add_one()
add_one()

questions.description: global 修改后全局生效。
questions.code_template:
value = 1
def update():
    global value
    value = 100

update()
print(___)
questions.solution:
value = 1
def update():
    global value
    value = 100

update()
print(value)

questions.description: 函数参数是局部变量。
questions.code_template:
def double(n):
    n = n * 2
    print(n)

x = 5
double(x)
print(___)
questions.solution:
def double(n):
    n = n * 2
    print(n)

x = 5
double(x)
print(x)

questions.description: 嵌套函数内层访问外层变量。
内层函数读取外层并输出。
全局变量在循环后输出。
questions.code_template:
i = 0
for i in range(3):
    pass
print(___)
questions.solution:
i = 0
for i in range(3):
    pass
print(i)

questions.description: 同名变量不同作用域。
questions.code_template:
x = 1
def f():
    x = 2
    return x

print(f())
print(___)
questions.solution:
x = 1
def f():
    x = 2
    return x

print(f())
print(x)

questions.description: 函数修改全局列表。
questions.code_template:
items = [1, 2]
def add():
    items.append(3)

add()
print(___)

def add():

questions.description: 全局变量与局部变量相加。

def f():
    y = 5
    print(___)

f()

def f():
    y = 5
    print(x + y)

f()

questions.description: 函数返回后局部变量消失。
questions.code_template:
def create():
    temp = 99
    return temp

result = create()
print(___)
questions.solution:
def create():
    temp = 99
    return temp

result = create()
print(result)

questions.description: 全局变量在多个函数中使用。
questions.code_template:
pi = 3.14
def area(r):
    return pi * r * r

print(___)
questions.solution:
pi = 3.14
def area(r):
    return pi * r * r

print(area(1))

questions.description: global 变量在循环中累加。
questions.code_template:
total = 0
def add(n):
    global total
    total += n

add(4)
add(6)
print("Total:",___)
questions.solution:
total = 0
def add(n):
    global total
    total += n

add(4)
add(6)
print("Total:", total)

questions.description: 函数返回多个局部变量。
questions.code_template:
def pair():
    a = 1
    b = 2
    return a, b

x, y = pair()
print(___, y)
questions.solution:
def pair():
    a = 1
    b = 2
    return a, b

x, y = pair()
print(x, y)
